main_idea: GRPO improved Qwen3.8-27B’s DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
ideas: GRPO raised DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points.
The training set included 500 tasks across 422 repositories.
The task mix was mostly feature requests.
Entropy stayed within a reported range.
summary: The reward, dataset, task mix, and entropy details distract from the pass-rate result; the graphic lacks nothing needed to understand it.
